e how MCPJam connects to and talks to your MCP servers. Returns the `id`s and `configId`s the detail and write routes take. Client
s that exist only as the private backing of a User Testing study are omitted unless `inclu…\n- [Create a client (from a template o
r a full config)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/create-a-client-from-a-template-or-a-full-config.md): Creates a cl
ient in the project and responds `201` with the new client's detail. Seed the config one of two ways: pass `template` (a built-in
template id, optional `theme`) to seed server-side from the live backend client-template catalog, falling back to the bundled SDK
catalog snapshot if the live…\n- [Get a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/get-a-client.md): One client's full
settings, including its resolved config, its `configId` (the concurrency token every write takes), and `impact` — what a config ed
it would follow. The path segment accepts a client **name or ID**. A client that exists but belongs to a different project reads a
s `404 NOT_FOUND`.\n- [Delete a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/delete-a-client.md): Permanently deletes the
client. Refused while a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite still holds it — the error names what to detach
first. Guest callers are denied (a write).\n- [Update a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/update-a-client.md):
Edit a client's display name and/or its config. Two ways to change the config: `config` replaces it wholesale, and `set` changes
named fields over the config read inside the write transaction — prefer `set`, because a whole-config round-trip composed from a s
tale read reverts whatever landed in betw…\n- [Replace a client's servers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/replace-a
-clients-servers.md): Replaces the client's required and optional saved-server attachments without round-tripping the whole config
. Composed server-side from the client's current config, so every other setting is preserved — and `expectedConfigId` is required
so two concurrent server replacements cannot silently lose one…\n- [Duplicate a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clie
nts/duplicate-a-client.md): Creates a new client carrying the selected client's current config, and responds `201` with the copy's
detail. Purely additive — the source is untouched.\n- [List server skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-
server-skills.md): Returns the Agent Skills a connected server serves over the MCP skills extension (SEP-2640), including skills i
t advertises that MCPJam declines to load. Not paginated: the catalog is drained server-side, because duplicate detection spans th
e whole listing.\n- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-his
tory.md): One entry per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note the
y left, how many runs were launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no conf
iguration snapshots. Send a `revisionNumber` back…\n- [Attach one environment to a suite (atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/
api-reference/eval-suites/attach-one-environment-to-a-suite-atomic-append.md): APPEND one project environment to the suite's attac
hments, if it is not already there.\n- [List GitHub Checks repositories](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/list-github-c
hecks-repositories.md): The repositories in this organization whose pull requests run an eval suite, plus the repositories the MCP
Jam GitHub App can reach (the choices a connect has).\n- [Run an eval suite on a repository's pull requests](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/evals/run-an-eval-suite-on-a-repositorys-pull-requests.md): Connect a repository so every pull request to it runs
one eval suite and reports a GitHub check. **Affects everyone who opens a pull request on that repository**, and with `outagePoli
cy: fail_closed` it can block their merges.\n- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/requ
est-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run an
d draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.\n- [Grade an eval run with LLM as J
udge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md): **Spends.** Runs the goal-completion ju
dge over the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.\n- [Save a server into a project](https:/
/docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/save-a-server-into-a-project.md): Creates a saved MCP server and responds `201` with its de
tail. This is the provisioning entry point: every eval, host and environment route addresses servers that were created here. Names
are unique per workspace, so a clash responds `409` rather than silently returning the existing row. Secret-bear…\n- [List a serv
er's revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/list-a-servers-revisions.md): A saved server's stored revisions, new
est first. A revision is a capture of the server's tools and server info, recorded whenever they change on a connect, an eval run
or a chat session. Reads stored data and never connects to the server, so it works for stdio servers too. A server the caller cann
ot…\n- [Get one saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/get-one-saved-server.md): The server's detail, project
ed toward the hosted shape. Secrets are never included — `hasClientSecret` reports presence only. A server id from another project
reads as `404`.\n- [Update a saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/update-a-saved-server.md): Sparse update
: omitted fields are unchanged. Renaming re-checks per-workspace uniqueness (`409` on a clash). Editing a server shared as an OAut
h connection requires project admin. `clientSecret` and `clearClientSecret` are mutually exclusive.\n- [Check what this deployment
's environment surface supports](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/check-what-this-deployments-environment-surfac
e-supports.md): Report which environment features this MCPJam deployment accepts. Call it before sending a model override: clients
